title: 操作繁琐且效率低下
description: 游戏操作需要大量重复点击、无法批量执行或取消，导致操作繁琐、效率低下，影响游戏体验。
evidence: Everything in this game requires multiple clicks. Many clicks
No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
items that you cannot place on the floor where you want and you have to keep taking and dropping them until they are where you want

evidence_items.quote: 跑去外面想拆船拆点墙和地板出来扩建船和修船骸居然不能直接下多个命令，要我一个一个点
evidence_items.description: 拆墙和地板时不能直接下多个命令，要一个一个点
evidence_items.quote_zh: 跑去外面想拆船拆点墙和地板出来扩建船和修船骸居然不能直接下多个命令，要我一个一个点

evidence_items.quote: you have to click an average of 3-5 times for every single tile
evidence_items.description: 手动拾取每块地砖需点击3-5次
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每块地砖平均都得点击3到5次

evidence_items.quote: You can stack floor tiles, but walls have to be placed one by one through dragging.
evidence_items.description: 墙壁必须逐个拖动放置，而地板可以堆叠
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你可以堆叠地板砖，但墙壁必须通过拖拽一块一块地放置。

evidence_items.quote: you can't queue actions and always have to quit actions manually before switching to another task
evidence_items.description: 无法排队动作，必须手动退出当前动作才能切换任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你无法排队执行动作，在切换到另一项任务之前总是必须手动取消动作

evidence_items.quote: the amount of clicking needed can get old at times
evidence_items.description: 需要大量点击，有时会感到厌烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 所需的点击量有时会让人感到厌烦

evidence_items.quote: changing batteries is a three action interaction- you open the tool, you open the container with your batteries, you swap batteries
evidence_items.description: 更换工具电池需要三步操作，繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 更换电池是一个三步交互——你打开工具，你打开装电池的容器，你更换电池

evidence_items.quote: items can be on the same square, repeated right-clicking to cycle through them
evidence_items.description: 物品在同一格时需反复右键循环选择
evidence_items.quote_zh: 物品可以位于同一格子上，反复右键点击来循环切换它们

evidence_items.quote: The ship salvage and building/rebuilding part of the game has very clicky mechanics, and in the latest pre-release those mechanics went from bad to worse.
evidence_items.description: 飞船打捞建造机制点击繁琐，最新预发布版物品放置更慢更不可靠
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏中打捞和建造/重建飞船的部分有着非常依赖点击的机制，而在最新的预发布版本中，那些机制从糟糕变得更糟。

evidence_items.quote: 我需要一個一個拖，一個一個點
evidence_items.description: 建造时需要逐个拖动和点击，操作繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我需要一個一個拖，一個一個點

evidence_items.quote: the flying mechanic just gets so tedious so quick that it ruins the fun from the other aspects of the game
evidence_items.description: 飞行操控繁琐，需要手动调整每个方面，令人厌烦
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞行机制很快就变得如此繁琐，以至于破坏了游戏其他方面带来的乐趣

evidence_items.quote: No way to 'cancel' a move command easily.
evidence_items.description: 无法轻松取消移动指令
evidence_items.quote_zh: 没有办法轻松地'取消'移动命令。

evidence_items.quote: controlling everything with a mouse click is super tedious
evidence_items.description: 全部用鼠标点击控制非常繁琐
evidence_items.quote_zh: 用鼠标点击来控制一切超级繁琐

evidence_items.quote: Everything in this game requires multiple clicks. Many clicks
evidence_items.description: 游戏中几乎所有操作都需要多次点击
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这个游戏里的所有东西都需要多次点击。很多次点击

evidence_items.quote: items that you cannot place on the floor where you want and you have to keep taking and dropping them until they are where you want
evidence_items.description: 物品无法放置在指定位置，需要反复拾取丢弃
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你无法把物品放在地板上你想要的位置，只能不停地拿起和放下，直到它们到你想要的地方
